jobs.name: Event-first workqueue drain (every 10 min; per-event detail-read/derive/enrich/ship)
Morning event-find (scrape approved seeds, LLM-extract → pending)
Evening event-find (scrape approved seeds, LLM-extract → pending)
Mark operator-confirmed cancellations on TownLoops (title prefix + cancelled tag; nothing without operator confirmation)
Weekly reconcile (re-pull seeds, cross-reference live TownLoops for date/venue changes + missing events, stage locally, enrich venues/hosts/images)
Weekly seed discovery (LLM proposes seed URLs → operator approves)
Daily feed probe (detect iCal/RSS/JSON-LD/vendor feeds on ≤4 seeds never probed; no-op once caught up)

Daily seed review (autonomous: assign adapters a seed's probed feed matches, dry-run proposed seeds, classify primary/syndicator, retire or relocate dead/rejected seeds; supervised: only propose adapters, in the nightly digest)
Performer/creator research (evidence ladder; ≤3 per run, ambiguous identities → operator review)
Promote approved organisation candidates (live check → enrich → ship; ≤3 per run; supervised: operator-approved only; autonomous: agent-approved, submitted pending)
Weekly organisation harvest (autonomous mode only: sweep + verify businesses, community groups, non-profits; approve verified; inactive in supervised mode)
Hourly moderation feedback (autonomous mode: read back published/rejected/merged outcomes of submissions, update seed trust, circuit breaker; no-op with nothing pending)

Daily entity live sync (resync shipped venues/hosts/people from TownLoops, PATCH enrichment into live blanks, GET-verify; set Ingest Refs on rows shipped before refs; re-read event Series + fill Series-shared blanks)
Weekly Series candidates (read-only: title Clusters that could become a Series, Series spanning several venues or with same-day duplicates) → report + Telegram
Daily TownLoops OpenAPI snapshot + breaking-change check
Nightly digest (events by state, workqueue depth, seeds) → report + Telegram
Sunday: compose the coming week's newsletter draft
jobs.prompt: Compute next week's ISO week (Mon-Sun ahead). Run `newsletter-weekly/newsletter.py compose --week <ISO>`. Read the draft body path from the JSON output; do NOT paste the whole HTML into Telegram. Send a summary: week label, entry count split into Series and one-off events (`series` / `singletons` in the JSON; `events` is the raw occurrence count), draft path, and a reminder that `push` requires operator approval. Do NOT push.

jobs.name: Sunday evening: nudge the operator to push the newsletter
jobs.prompt: Look up the current draft newsletter (this week's ISO week) via `newsletter-weekly/newsletter.py show`. If status is 'draft', message the operator with the exact `push --week <ISO>` command to run and ask for approval. If status is already 'scheduled' or 'sent', do nothing. Do NOT push without explicit operator instruction.

jobs.name: Monday: sponsor placement audit
jobs.prompt: Run `sponsor-management/sponsors.py audit`. Format the JSON as a short digest: (1) 'Expiring soon' — one line per ad_spot with placement + ends_at; (2) 'Unbound sponsors' — sponsors with no active placement. If both lists are empty, send a single line 'sponsors: all clear'. Do NOT take action; the operator drives assignments.
